🗓 **TAWG Daily Catch-up**
_2026-09-14 23:00 → 2026-09-15 23:00 UTC_

## ⚡ **Highlights**

> **zkIE negative-test loop closed** — Four negative tests were corrected to load both byte tables and independently verified in a clean worktree the same hour, completing a tight fix-to-review loop. [PR #4 review](https://github.com/trustless-ai/zkIE/pull/4#pullrequestreview-5204634208)

> **recompute-kit manifests independently cross-verified** — Two separate cold-recompute passes — one hand-verified across five runtimes, one via a clean-room repo — both confirmed matching hashes and manifest entries, giving the conformance PR strong external backing. [tg:tawg:4696]

> **RSI chain sealed with green CI** — Verification report, addendum, and frozen derivation are now publicly preserved in RSI with passing CI, making this window's verification work durable. [tg:tawg:4698]

## 🤝 **What moved**

### recompute-kit
_The conformance PR moved through multi-layer independent verification and into secure archival within a single window._

- Merlini (@gobross) **Opened** a PR chaining both ends of the profile-commitment-loop-v0 conformance into one mechanical seam, directly advancing recompute-kit's ability to deliver end-to-end verifiable credentials for the Trustless AI pipeline. [PR #42](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/42)

- Zexo **Performed** a cold recompute of the PR head across five runtimes — Python, Bun, and Node — confirming every hash and pin matches, giving the conformance loop an independent hash-level check before merge. [PR #42 review](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/42#pullrequestreview-5204994678)

- Baby Blue Viper (@babyblueviper1) **Posted** an independent POST_COMMIT_VERIFIER comparison, adding an external cross-check that strengthens confidence in the derivation output for the group's shared verification standard. [tg:tawg:4694]

- Baby Blue Viper (@babyblueviper1) **Added** an addendum after accepting a clean-room repo invite, recomputing the package manifest and hash file at a pinned commit and confirming both match, closing the independent manifest verification loop. [tg:tawg:4696]

- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Confirmed** that the verification report, addendum, and frozen derivation are preserved in a public RSI repository with green CI, securing the full evidence chain for durable reference by the group. [tg:tawg:4698]

### zkIE
_The negative-test coverage gap was fixed, independently reviewed, and connected to an active forum thread._

- Zexo (@zexoverz) **Opened** PR #4 correcting four negative tests to load both byte tables, confirming they now reject for the right reasons after forgery removal, and closing a test-correctness gap that could have let invalid credentials pass silently. [tg:tawg:4690]

- Zexo **Confirmed** on Ethereum Magicians that the correct commit shape is in place and the in-tree suite runs clean, giving the ERC-8380 discussion a concrete verified anchor. [ERC-8380 post](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8380-unclonable-agent-execution-credentials/29274/35)

- Jimmy Shi **Reviewed** the PR diff and ran the full test suite in a clean worktree at the PR head, providing independent confirmation that clears the path to merge. [PR #4 review](https://github.com/trustless-ai/zkIE/pull/4#pullrequestreview-5204634208)

### ERC-8004
_A concrete real-world deployment instance enriched the ongoing spec discussion._

- Baby Blue Viper **Shared** a live production deployment example on Ethereum Magicians, giving the ERC-8004 discussion empirical grounding about how trustless agents operate in practice. [ERC-8004 post](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8004-trustless-agents/25098/399)

## 🚀 **Next up**

### 💡 **Ideas to follow**
- A contributor noted a blocker preventing corrected files from landing in a recompute-kit issue — understanding that path could open another contribution avenue.
- The zkIE and ERC-8380 directions are now aligned at a verified commit — watching for follow-up spec questions in the forum thread.

### ✅ **TODOs**
- zkIE PR #4 has an independent review complete — confirm merge readiness and surface any follow-up findings.
- Recompute-kit PR #42 has multi-layer verification complete — move to final merge review.
- Monitor the open recompute-kit issue for the missing corrected files.

## 🤖 **Trusty's take**

> **Today's spark:** The recompute-kit conformance PR moved from freshly opened to five-runtime cold-hash verified to clean-room manifest recomputed to RSI archived — all within a single window, with a different contributor stepping in at each relay leg.
>
> When the whole team runs the hash gauntlet together, the verification chain ends up proving itself — keep the relay going! 🔍
